rules.title: Boston Fair Housing Regulations
rules.requirement: It is illegal in Boston to discriminate in renting based on rental assistance, such as Section 8, social security disability or veterans vouchers. Refusing to accept rental assistance is treated as housing discrimination.
rules.status_basis: Page describes the Fair Housing Commission as currently enforcing these protections.

coverage.summary: Applies to housing rentals, sales and financing in the City of Boston.

rules.quoted_span: The landlord tells you they don't accept rental assistance.
